name: Прут — Ворохта
source: geohydroai-storms experiments/era5land-recal/calibrate.R: airGR 1.7.9 Calibration_Michel, forcing ERA5-Land (CDS 0.1°, basin area-weighted, 20:00→20:00 Kyiv day), T lapsed to the basin mean FABDEM elevation, PET Oudin, CemaNeige 5 layers; Q over the official area; geohydroai-storms PR #8 @ 2e88eb8 results/proposed_params/42249.1d.json

calibration.forcing: ERA5-Land daily_climuad, basin mean (area-weighted 0.1° cells), 20:00→20:00 Kyiv day; T lapsed −6.5 K/km to z_mean; no precipitation factor
calibration.engine: airGR 1.7.9 Calibration_Michel, CemaNeige-GR4J, 5 elevation layers, PET Oudin
calibration.qc_mask: observations 1981-01-01…2013-12-31 excluded: annual runoff / ERA5-Land P above 1 (0.6-1.38, 12 of 33 years > 1) until 2013, 0.28-0.73 from 2014: two regimes that one rainfall-runoff model cannot both match; the forecast must match today's record, so only 2014-2023 enters (rating / section change suspected, to be confirmed)
calibration.sets: reference (1981-2023) + C_S1/C_S2 split-sample + MC1-3 behavioural (C ≥ C_ref − 0.03); sets at airGR bounds dropped

forcing_contract.precip: ERA5-Land basin mean, no factor (ICON-EU adjusted to it in operation)
forcing_contract.temperature: ERA5-Land t2m lapsed −6.5 K/km to z_mean

skill.note: on ERA5-Land forcing (not the operational chain); split-sample validation = mean of both directions; 'current' = the prut-network-gr4j-climuad-2026-10-16 reference set run on the same ERA5-Land forcing

note: set 'reference' = calibrated on the whole 1981-2023 record; C_S1/C_S2 = split-sample calibrations (independently validated); MC1-3 = behavioural sets around the reference (criterion within 0.03 on 1981-2023). Ensemble = these sets × precip 1.0 only. Model result, not an observation.
